title: RejectedAgentOutputLog
description: Transient advisory-security telemetry emitted when the advisory containment gate rejects unsafe or invalid runtime advisory output. This log is not canonical truth, not a retry queue, and must contain only bounded excerpts.

contract_version.description: Contract version identifier for the RejectedAgentOutputLog schema instance.

log_id.description: Stable identifier for the rejected advisory log entry.

logged_at_utc.description: UTC timestamp when the rejection was logged.

agent_name.description: Runtime advisory agent whose output was rejected.

reason_class.description: Deterministic rejection class assigned by schema validation or operator-intent classification.

raw_excerpt.description: Short bounded excerpt of the raw advisory response, with no secrets or raw evidence content.

parsed_excerpt.description: Short bounded excerpt of the parsed advisory object or validation failure context, with no secrets or raw evidence content.

input_ref.description: Reference to the AgentInputContract instance used for the rejected advisory attempt.

action_taken.description: Fixed action taken by the containment gate.

notes.description: Bounded non-secret notes about the rejection.
